fields.name: url
fields.help: Use this URL in the third-party app to call this webhook.

fields.name: record_getter
fields.help: This code will be run to find on which record the automation rule should be run.

fields.name: active
fields.help: When unchecked, the rule is hidden and will not be executed.

fields.name: trg_selection_field_id
fields.help: Some triggers need a reference to a selection field. This field is used to store it.

fields.name: trg_field_ref
fields.help: Some triggers need a reference to another field. This field is used to store it.

fields.name: trg_date_id
fields.help:
When should the condition be triggered.
                If present, will be checked by the scheduler. If empty, will be checked at creation and update.

fields.name: trg_date_calendar_id
fields.help: When calculating a day-based timed condition, it is possible to use a calendar to compute the date based on working days.

fields.name: filter_pre_domain
fields.help: If present, this condition must be satisfied before the update of the record. Not checked on record creation.

fields.name: filter_domain
fields.help: If present, this condition must be satisfied before executing the automation rule.

fields.name: trigger_field_ids
fields.help: The automation rule will be triggered if and only if one of these fields is updated.If empty, all fields are watched.

the same model anymore.

copying the automation itself.

Execute the webhook for the given payload.
The payload is a dictionnary that can be used by the `record_getter` to
identify the record on which the automation should be run.

definitions.documentation:
Activate the cron job depending on whether there exists automation rules
based on time conditions.  Also update its frequency according to
the smallest automation delay, or restore the default 4 hours if there
is no time based automation.
Update the registry after a modification on automation rules.

Return the automations of the given triggers for records' model. The
returned automations' context contain an object to manage processing.

Prepare the context used when evaluating python code

Return the expected time interval used by the cron, in minutes or hours.
Filter the records that satisfy the precondition of automation ``self``.
Filter the records that satisfy the postcondition of automation ``self``.
Process automation ``self`` on the ``records`` that have not been done yet.
Return whether any of the trigger fields has been modified on ``record``.

Patch models that should trigger action rules based on creation,
modification, deletion of records and form onchanges.

window_actions.name: Automation Rules
window_actions.help:
Automate everything with Automation Rules

Send an email when an object changes state, archive records after a month of inactivity or remind yourself to follow-up on tasks when a specific tag is added.

With Automation Rules, you can automate any workflow.
